test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’.

‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’.

‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’.

If A + B # C % D # E, which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: C is the father of A.
B is sister of E’s son.
D is the mother of B’s husband.
A is the daughter of E’s son.

solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 %
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Son
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: A + B # C % D # E

It means: A is the Daughter of B, B is the Wife of C, C is the Son of D, D is the Wife of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a8b83dda1c621e77ada6317106a2f8315d4a8bd45eb6b086ec0e1fbfcff87f8.png] 

Option 1) C is the father of A → True.

Option 2) B is sister of E’s son → **False**.

Option 3) D is the mother of B’s husband → True.

Option 4) A is the daughter of E’s son → True.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
